title: Recording, mixing: Beef Jerky by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

The first recording session for John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album took place on 14 July 1974.

The session began with rehearsals of ‘Move Over Ms L’, ‘Bless You’, ‘Whatever Gets You Thru The Night’, and ‘What You Got’.

Lennon and the session musicians then began recording ‘Beef Jerky’. Towards the end of the session a rough mix was made of the best take.
